name: Hats Off: NPC conversation hides the hat and gives it back after

steps.msg: precondition: Glamourer connected, Hats Off on and idle
precondition: turn on the NPC conversation option in /hatsoff
precondition: on foot, no cutscene, no NPC interaction

steps.mark: target the nearest NPC and talk

steps.msg: a dialogue box should open (precondition: right next to a regular NPC with chat, no vendor)
Hats Off should hide the hat for the conversation
the hat should actually disappear (precondition: wearing headgear that is shown)
the hat must stay hidden while the dialogue box is up
the conversation should end (precondition: an NPC with a one-box chat; else add pad Cross steps)
the hat stays hidden during the 'keep hidden after a conversation' delay
the hat should come back after the delay (default 2 s)
Hats Off should be idle again
no hat flicker at any point
no warnings or errors from Hats Off
